author: Kuokka77
description:
Muffler's main part music for Nah-kolor's Supersonic demo. Demo ranked 3rd at Xenium 2026.
Art from the demo by .misha. or Vasyl, not sure which one.

A1200 r1D.4 audio. Recorded from a running demo.

Demo in action recorded from real A1200 by Estrayk:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d1f8aYaJ_DA
title: Amiga music: Muffler - Supersonic (demo main part) (A1200 raw)

author: Kuokka77
description:
"xyr" by Cosmiq/Inque, 6th at Evoke 2026 tracked music - head-noddin' beat compo.
Art "Space Tree" also by Cosmiq/Inque, 3rd at Evoke 2026 pixel gfx compo.

OpenMPT 1.26.14.00 (Win98SE + KernelEx) and AWE64 Gold. Linear (2-tap) interpolation. Volume ramping 198 up, 323 down. Stereo width set to 150% (more close match to GUS hardware mixing results). OMPT used for its much better control of software mixing parameters (vs. FastTracker).
title: FastTracker music: Cosmiq - xyr (AWE64 Gold)
